49310.commentary: (DNa) bhattavetan'ānuppadānenā'ti ayaṃ khuddakaputto, ayaṃ ekavihārī'ti tassa tassa anurūpaṃ sallakkhetvā bhattadānena c'eva paribbayadānena ca. (DNt) bhattavetan'ānuppadānenā'ti tassa tassa dāsakammakarassa anurūpaṃ bhattassa, vetanassa ca padānena.

examples.text: pañcahi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi ayyirakena heṭṭhimā disā dāsakammakarā paccupaṭṭhātabbā, yathābalaṃ kamm'antasaṃvidhānena bhattavetan'ānuppadānena gilān'upaṭṭhānena acchariyānaṃ rasānaṃ saṃvibhāgena samaye vossaggena.
rājabhoggo nāma yo koci rañño bhattavetan'āhāro.
cakk'ānuvattanā rājā, yassaṃdisaṃ dve c'eva patthanā, appaṃsupati bhatt'ādo, akkhamo ca sotena cā'ti.
pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo bhatt'ādako ca hoti okāsapharaṇo ca laṇḍasāraṇo ca salākaggāhī ca rañño nāgo'tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. katamehi pañcahi?
ehi tvaṃ, tāta sudassana, bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā mama bhatt'ābhihāre bhāsa. ahañ'ca te devasikaṃ kahāpaṇasataṃ bhikkhaṃ pavattayissāmī'ti.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītithālipākasahassāni ahesuṃ, sāyaṃ pātaṃ bhatt'ābhihāro abhihariyittha.

icchām'ahaṃ, bho, vassike cattāro māse paṭisallīyituṃ, karuṇaṃ jhānaṃ jhāyituṃ, n'amhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo aññatra ekena bhatt'ābhihārenā'ti.
n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, pariyāyabhattikassa pariyāyabhattikamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi.
